metadata.source: OpenStreetMap contributors via Geofabrik Jordan extract
metadata.featureSelectionPolicy: Include explicit Muslim mosque/place-of-worship tags and explicit prayer-room/musalla tags with an Islamic signal; a narrow name-only mosque fallback is allowed only when no conflicting street, settlement, boundary, landuse, or non-religious building tags exist.
metadata.coordinatePolicy: Use exact OSM node locations or representative points on valid mapped areas; require coverage by the Jordan admin_level=2 boundary. No geocoding or administrative-centre estimates.
metadata.matchPolicy: An OSM mosque feature is linked to a Ministry record only by exact normalized name plus exact area context, or by a name unique in both the Ministry registry and Jordan OSM extract. Ambiguous and reused matches are excluded.
